EY is hiring an entry-level Java Developer - Analyst to support financial services clients by building backend services, APIs, and data integrations. The role contributes to the analysis, development, testing, delivery, and support of enterprise technology solutions.

Responsibilities
Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions
The goal is to help clients solve complex business problems by delivering robust enterprise solutions
You will assist with analysis, development, testing, and support, learn the team’s tools and standards, and contribute to assigned workstreams under the guidance of experienced colleagues
Assist with development, testing, and support tasks, and contribute to assigned workstreams
Learn and apply the team’s code quality, security, testing, and automation standards

Required
Foundational knowledge of building server-side services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and RESTful web services, with support from experienced colleagues
Foundational knowledge of microservices concepts and messaging or event streaming platforms such as Kafka or JMS
Foundational knowledge of relational and NoSQL database design and SQL, including writing and tuning queries and stored procedures
Foundational knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Azure
Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
Eagerness to learn new and rapidly changing technologies
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
A minimum of 1 year relevant experience in enterprise application development
Exposure to Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, and object-oriented programming fundamentals
Foundational knowledge of building and consuming RESTful APIs
Familiarity with JSON, XML, REST, SOAP, and web services
Exposure to SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL
Familiarity with messaging platforms such as Kafka or JMS
Exposure to Git, CI/CD, and unit testing concepts
Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders
intellectually curious people with a passion for finding new and innovative ways to make things better
a self-starter and quick learner with a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view
Preferred

Jenkins, Git, and CI/CD pipelines
JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks
Cloud development, production triage, and enterprise application delivery

Pension and 401(k) plans
A wide range of paid time off options
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances
Time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being
